key.name: max-working-hours
key.description: Target number of hours to work per day, used to compute the percentage of the target already worked today. Set to 0 to disable.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Whether to append the percentage of the working-hours target reached so far today to the panel label and menu status text. The progress bar in the menu is unaffected by this setting and is shown whenever max-working-hours is greater than 0.

key.name: lock-grace-minutes
key.description: If the screen is unlocked again within this many minutes of being locked, the locked time is counted as working time rather than a break, and the break is not counted. Set to 0 to count every lock as a break immediately. Manual pauses are always counted as breaks regardless of this setting.
